name: forgot-password-template
title: Forgot Password (template)
description: Forgot- and reset-password page templates inside the Auth Layout. ForgotPassword: the email, then "Check your email" without saying whether an account exists, with Resend link after a cooldown and Use a different email. ResetPassword, the page the link opens: a new password with its rules ticked off as the reader types, then "Password changed" and Sign in. Each hands valid values to its handler and shows the message it returns.
